LanguageData.UFR_MixerIdle: Not mixing. Needs power, ground aggregate on its aggregate network, and ferrocrete tank space on its ferrocrete pipeline.
LanguageData.UFR_KilnIdle: Not firing. Needs power and stored ferrocrete mix on its ferrocrete pipeline.
LanguageData.UFR_FerrocreteValveDesc: Open or close the valve to allow or block ferrocrete mix flow. A pawn will come to switch it.
LanguageData.UFR_AggregateValveDesc: Open or close the valve to allow or block ground aggregate flow. A pawn will come to switch it.
